permitted_action.label: Continue to the next value surface
permitted_action.meaning: Record one non-PII interaction observation only; it does not imply intent, permission, demand, PMF, or revenue.

principles: Admitted append-only history is the semantic source; current state is reconstructed rather than independently hand-edited.
One deterministic kernel reduces current meaning and projects actor or subject-context surfaces.
A surface is accumulated current value plus permitted next actions.
A user receives a next value surface; use of that surface may become the next observation.
A gesture creates a typed candidate, not accepted meaning; admission precedes any effect.
Effect execution, provider response, readback, observation, and business outcome remain distinct.
Observations return to append-only history and cause deterministic re-projection.
UI, databases, manifests, receipts, funnels, scores, and provider responses are not independent accepted-meaning authority.
summary: Reconstruct current meaning from admitted append-only history, project the next value surface, admit effects explicitly, and return observations to the same history.
title: Log-projected application kernel
